title: HUB v2
features:
🚀 Core Script Features
🎯 Advanced Aimbot Engine
Field of View (FOV): Set to a precise 100 Radius to ensure you lock onto targets within your vision without looking "snappy" or suspicious.
Wall Check Logic: The script uses GetPartsObscuringTarget to verify if a player is behind a wall. It only locks on if the player is visible, making your gameplay look natural.
Smooth Tracking: Integrated with RenderStepped for frame-perfect camera movement.
👁️ Visuals & ESP (Highlights)
Player Highlighting: Uses the modern Highlight instance to create a glowing silhouette around enemies.
Wallhack Ready: See enemies through walls and obstacles clearly with high-visibility outlines.
Instant Toggle: Turn visuals on or off instantly via the Rayfield menu without lag.
👑 Staff & Bypass System
Owner Access: Specifically hardcoded for sussybak995696. This role grants an automatic Key System Bypass and a "Owner 👑" rank label.
Advertiser Role: Specialized role for staff like oweniscertified. Advertisers get the same Key Bypass powers and a unique "Advertiser 📢" rank.
Auto-Cleaning GUI: The "Get Key" button automatically deletes itself from the screen once the hub is loaded or if you are staff.
🛡️ Security & UI
Hard Key System: Protected by a unique security key.
Rayfield Interface: Built on the premium Rayfield library for a smooth, lag-free, and mobile-friendly user experience.
Auto-Save Ready: Structure is set up to allow for configuration saving in future updates.
